evidence.quote: the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent
recent indicators suggest that growth of economic activity moderated in the first half of the year
In considering the extent and timing of additional adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate
Voting against this action were Michelle W. Bowman and Christopher J. Waller, who preferred to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point at this meeting.
The Committee will continue reducing its holdings of Treasury securities and agency debt and agency mortgage‑backed securities.

parsed.rationale: The Committee held rates steady with balanced risk language and elevated inflation, but noted moderating growth and retained easing-bias guidance about additional adjustments. Two dissents favoring a cut add a mild dovish tilt.
